rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: moveup:2.2: can: 642-strip0.jpg system 2: in stanza 2's row the moved word (a pronoun of God) and the word after it (a name of God) both take capitals anyway and no metre is printed, but stanzas 1 and 3, under the same notes, open line 3 on the moved word's note with a capital after a semicolon, and stanza 3 prints a lowercase word on the note where the change opens line 3. The change gives stanza 2's lines 2 and 3 7 and 7 syllables where the other stanzas sing 6 and 8.
